source: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual Volume 2A
method: Official Intel PDF opened and relevant text read through web tool; no complete download or PDF hash claimed.
facts: Operand-size prefix66 selects the non-default16/32bit size.
Opcode98 at16bit operand size signextendsAL intoAX; at32bit size signextendsAX intoEAX.
Opcode99 at16bit size signextendsAX intoDX:AX; at32bit size signextendsEAX intoEDX:EAX.
These sign-extension operations do not modify flags; mnemonic synonyms alone do not establish operand width.
limits: Primary ISA corroboration only, no physical CPU/historical timing or DOS/game session acceptance. Raw original bytes and separate full-register synthetic instruction checks establish the selected recovery interpretation.
